blocks.content: Order your stages by how quickly they can tell you something is wrong. Lint and typecheck in seconds, unit tests in a minute, integration and end-to-end last.

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npx tsc --noEmit
      - run: npm test -- --run

blocks.title: Cache the right thing
blocks.content: Cache the dependency store keyed on the lockfile hash, never node_modules itself. A stale module tree produces failures that reproduce nowhere else.
